preconditions.description: The number of movements made by the operator is between 1 and 2 billion inclusive.
The index of the shell where the ball was found after n movements is between 0 and 2 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The index of the shell where the ball was initially placed is between 0 and 2 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (x + n % 2) % 3 if n % 2 == 0 else (x - n % 2) % 3
postconditions.description: The initial position of the ball can be determined based on the final position and the number of movements.
